title: Most Gentle, Most Fierce
translation: We bow to her who is most gentle and most fierce; salutations to her again and again. Salutations to the foundation of the world, to the Goddess who is action itself.
translation_hi: अत्यंत सौम्य और अत्यंत रौद्र रूप वाली देवी को हम झुककर बार बार नमस्कार करते हैं। जगत की आधारस्वरूपा, क्रियारूपा देवी को बार बार नमस्कार है।

words.meaning: to the foundation of the world

grammar: Ati- 'very': अतिसौम्य, अतिरौद्र. Hindi uses the same: अति सुंदर.
Tasyai 'to her': the dative of सा, the word that becomes the refrain नमस्तस्यै in the next verses.
Saumya: from soma, the moon: gentle and cool like moonlight.
